remarks: Meticulously maintained three bedrooms, two and a half baths home nestled in one of Darein's highly sought after neighborhoods. Once inside, you are in a fully remodeled, and pristine home. The open concept dining room and Eat-in-kitchen with stainless appliances. This home boast includes New siding, New gutter and downspouts, New driveway, New custom patio, Professional landscape, New windows, New 200amp service, New light, switches and outlets, New hardwood floors, New custom kitchen, New quartz countertops, fully renovated bathrooms, New central AC, No flood insurance needed.
